value_stream.name: Inventory Pledge, Asset-Based Lending & Trust-Receipt (Warehouse-Receipt) Financing

fields.Owner: Treasurer / ABL & Collateral Operations Manager / Legal
fields.Trigger: Facility maturity; refinance decision; excess-liquidity paydown; collateral release request

workflows.name: Facility Paydown, Collateral Release & Exit/Refinance Management

Automation Opportunity: - Maturity calendar; release-of-security workflow; encumbrance-register auto-update; new-facility data carry-forward
Controls: - CTL-742 (ensure controlled execution — Collateral Release, Reconciliation, Compliance & Analytics (PA-170.3).)
- CTL-742: paydown/refinance board-approved; security formally released; encumbrance register updated; transition sequenced
Cross-references: - links to VS-18 (treasury), VS-100 (legal/release), VS-05/VS-29 (inventory release), VS-17.4 (notes), W4937 (new facility), W4948/W4949/W4951 (collateral), W4955 (disclosure)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Transition-gap risk**: Collateral released before new facility in place → uncovered period; mitigated by sequenced transition planning
- **Residual-encumbrance risk**: Security interest not formally released → stale encumbrance/disclosure; mitigated by the release documentation and register update
- **Refinance-timing risk**: Maturity hit without refinancing in place → default; mitigated by the maturity calendar and early RFP
System Touchpoints: - Treasury/debt facility (VS-18); security/pledge register (VS-100/VS-88); inventory status release (VS-05/VS-29); GL/notes (VS-17.4)

steps.activity: Manage the paydown/refinance/exit: at maturity or strategic refinance (W4937), plan the paydown (from cash/SCF/collections), the new facility transition, and the collateral release schedule; coordinate with the bank/agent and Legal (VS-100.3) on termination/release documentation

Execute collateral release: on paydown/termination, release the inventory/AR pledge (W4951), the trust-receipt residual (W4948), and warehouse-receipt collateral (W4949); record the release of security interest, reclassify any residual goods-in-trust to owned, and update the encumbrance register/disclosure (W4955)

Close the facility & transition: settle final interest/charges (W4959), terminate covenants/reporting, archive the facility file, transition to the new facility (W4937) if refinancing, and report the exit to management/board (VS-36)

fields.Owner: ABL & Collateral Operations Manager / Finance / Controller
fields.Trigger: Each borrowing-base cycle (W4939); close (VS-17.1); field exam (W4943)
fields.Volume: ~2–4 reconciliations per facility per cycle × 1–3 facilities

Automation Opportunity: - Auto-reconciliation borrowing-base↔subledgers; variance auto-flag & categorize; master-data-quality feed (VS-29)
Controls: - CTL-742 (ensure controlled execution — Collateral Release, Reconciliation, Compliance & Analytics (PA-170.3).)
- CTL-742: monthly reconciliation; variances investigated & resolved; ≥97% inventory accuracy; master-data governed
Cross-references: - links to VS-17 (GL), VS-05/VS-16 (inventory/AR subledgers), VS-29 (master data), W4939 (certificate), W4940/W4941 (eligibility), W4943/W4958 (audit)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Variance risk**: Borrowing base ≠ subledgers → certificate misstatement/over-advance; mitigated by monthly reconciliation and variance root-cause
- **Data-quality risk**: Poor inventory/AR data → chronic variances and exam true-downs; mitigated by the ≥97% accuracy target and master-data governance (VS-29)
- **Recurring-error risk**: Same variance recurs; mitigated by corrective controls
System Touchpoints: - Treasury/borrowing-base (VS-18); inventory subledger/GL (VS-05/VS-17); AR subledger (VS-16); master data (VS-29); analytics (VS-28)
Time Estimate: - ~2–3 business days per monthly reconciliation (automated with exception handling)

steps.activity: Reconcile the borrowing base to the subledgers: tie eligible inventory (W4940) to the inventory subledger/GL, eligible AR (W4941) to the AR subledger, identify and explain variances (timing, ineligibles, reserves, shrink), and document the reconciliation
Investigate & resolve variances: root-cause variances (data quality VS-29, posting timing, status errors), correct the data/process, and document for the certificate (W4939) and audit (W4943/W4958)

Govern data quality for the borrowing base: the inventory accuracy target (≥97%), AR aging integrity, master-data quality (VS-29), and the controls that prevent recurrence; report to management and the bank

fields.Owner: Controller / ABL & Collateral Operations Manager / Finance
fields.Volume: ~1 borrowing-base disclosure per facility × 1–3 facilities × 5 entities

workflows.name: PFRS Encumbrance Disclosure, PAS 37 / Contingent-Liability Reporting & Note Reconciliation

Automation Opportunity: - Encumbrance auto-disclosure from security register; note-to-face auto-recon; contingent-liability auto-roll from W325
Controls: - CTL-742 (ensure controlled execution — Collateral Release, Reconciliation, Compliance & Analytics (PA-170.3).)
- CTL-742 (disclosure reconciles to GL/security register; notes reconcile to statements; contingent liabilities complete; audited (VS-21))
Cross-references: - links to VS-17.4 (notes), VS-18 (W319/W325 facility/contingent), VS-100 (security), VS-21 (audit), W4939 (borrowing base), W4951 (perfection), W4944 (covenant submission)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Disclosure-misstatement risk**: Encumbered assets/borrowings mis-stated → audit qualification; mitigated by reconciliation and workpapers
- **Note-reconciliation risk**: Notes ≠ face of statements; mitigated by the reconciliation control
- **Contingent-liability omission risk**: Guarantees/cross-entity commitments omitted; mitigated by the contingent-liability register (W325)
System Touchpoints: - GL/notes (VS-17.4); treasury/debt facility (VS-18); security register (VS-100); contingent-liability register (W325); analytics (VS-28)
Time Estimate: - ~quarterly disclosure 3–5 days; ~annual audit support absorbed into close

steps.activity: Prepare the PFRS encumbrance/borrowing disclosure: the carrying amount and classification of borrowings (current/non-current), the encumbered inventory/AR (carrying amount and nature of encumbrance — pledge/trust/warehouse-receipt), the facility terms/availability, and contingent liabilities (guarantees W325, cross-entity) per PFRS/PAS disclosure requirements

Reconcile to the ledger & facility: tie disclosure to the GL (VS-17), the borrowing base (W4939), the security register (W4951), and the contingent-liability register (W325); ensure the notes reconcile to the face of the statements

Support external audit (VS-21): provide the disclosure workpapers, facility agreements, security/perfection evidence (W4951), and reconciliations; manage audit findings; and submit the audited statements to the bank (covenant W4944)

fields.Owner: Treasury / ABL & Collateral Operations Manager / FP&A
fields.Trigger: Periodic review; refinance decision (W4937); strategic review (VS-33)

Automation Opportunity: - Effective-rate auto-calc; cost-of-debt analytics; facility-utilization dashboards; optimization scenario modeling
Controls: - CTL-742 (ensure controlled execution — Collateral Release, Reconciliation, Compliance & Analytics (PA-170.3).)
- CTL-742: financing cost reconciled to bank charges (W4959); effective-rate documented; optimization recommendations reviewed by CFO
Cross-references: - links to VS-18 (treasury), VS-17.4/VS-33 (FP&A/strategy), VS-105 (SCF), VS-36 (board), W4937 (strategy), W4959 (charges)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Cost-leakage risk**: Unused commitment fees on over-sized facility; mitigated by utilization analytics and resize
- **Sub-optimal-mix risk**: Over-reliance on expensive collateralized debt vs SCF (VS-105); mitigated by the cost-of-capital analysis
- **Decision-lag risk**: Slow optimization response to rate/market change; mitigated by quarterly deep-dive
System Touchpoints: - Treasury/analytics (VS-18/VS-28); FP&A (VS-17.4/VS-33); bank portal (charges W4959); consolidation (VS-17)

steps.activity: Compute financing cost & effective rate: the all-in cost (interest margin, commitment fee, utilization fee, field-exam fees, collateral-manager fees, bank charges W4959) against drawn/undrawn, the effective rate per facility and blended, and the cost-vs-WACC/benchmark comparison

Analyze capital structure & cost-of-capital: the debt/equity mix, the collateralized vs uncollateralized split, the cost-of-debt impact on EBITDA/net-income, the working-capital-freed value, and the optimal facility/utilization profile (links VS-105 SCF, VS-18.2 cash)

Recommend optimization: refinance/resize/restructure recommendations, the SCF-vs-ABL-vs-TR trade-off, advance-rate/eligibility improvements, and feed strategy (W4937) and the board/finance committee (VS-36/VS-33)

fields.Owner: ABL & Collateral Operations Manager / Internal Audit (VS-21) / Financial Crime (VS-86)
fields.Participants: Finance (VS-17), Treasury (VS-18), Inventory (VS-05), AR (VS-16), Internal Audit (VS-21), Compliance (VS-86)
fields.Trigger: Continuous monitoring; certificate (W4939); field exam (W4943); anomaly alert

Automation Opportunity: - Over-advance auto-alert; proceeds-diversion pattern detection; trust-depletion-vs-proceeds auto-recon; exception escalation workflow
Controls: - CTL-742 (ensure controlled execution — Collateral Release, Reconciliation, Compliance & Analytics (PA-170.3).)
- CTL-742 (availability-first funding; proceeds segregated & monitored; anomalies investigated & escalated; audited (VS-21/VS-86))
Cross-references: - links to VS-21 (audit), VS-86 (financial crime), VS-100 (legal), W4939 (certificate), W4942 (availability), W4947/W4948 (proceeds), W4943 (field exam)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Over-advance risk**: Drawing > availability → immediate default; mitigated by availability-first controls (W4942) and over-advance detection
- **Diversion risk**: Trust proceeds diverted → PD 115 criminal liability + default; mitigated by proceeds segregation and diversion detection
- **Detection-lag risk**: Fraud undetected until field exam; mitigated by continuous monitoring (not just periodic)
System Touchpoints: - Treasury/borrowing-base (VS-18); analytics/exception monitoring (VS-28/VS-21.3); trust-receipt proceeds (VS-18); financial-crime (VS-86); inventory/AR (VS-05/VS-16)

steps.activity: Detect over-advance: continuously test that availability (W4942) ≥ outstanding, that the certificate (W4939) excludes ineligibles (W4940/W4941), and that draws don't exceed availability; alert on over-advance, certificate misstatement, or eligibility erosion

Detect proceeds diversion (PD 115): monitor trust-receipt proceeds segregation (W4947) vs remittance (W4948), flag commingling/diversion patterns, reconcile trust-goods depletion to proceeds, and detect ghost sales/under-reporting (links VS-86 financial-crime)

Investigate & escalate: investigate anomalies (data error vs fraud), escalate confirmed issues to Internal Audit (VS-21)/Legal (VS-100)/the bank per the agreement, manage remediation and potential self-disclosure, and document for the audit trail
steps.r: Internal Audit / Legal / ABL Manager / Compliance

fields.Owner: Internal Audit (VS-21) / ABL & Collateral Operations Manager
fields.Participants: Internal Audit (VS-21), Finance (VS-17), Treasury (VS-18), Legal (VS-100), External Audit
fields.Trigger: Audit plan (VS-21); field exam (W4943); bank request; issue identified (W4957)
fields.Volume: ~1 program audit per cycle + issue remediation

workflows.name: Internal Audit, Bank Covenant Assurance & Issue Remediation

Automation Opportunity: - Audit-test automation on the borrowing base; CAPA auto-tracking; bank-finding coordination log; control dashboards
Controls: - CTL-742 (ensure controlled execution — Collateral Release, Reconciliation, Compliance & Analytics (PA-170.3).)
- CTL-742: annual audit completed; issues logged & remediated; CAPA tracked; bank-covenant assurance reported
Cross-references: - links to VS-21 (audit/CAPA), VS-36 (audit committee), VS-100 (legal), W4943 (field exam), W4939–W4952 (program areas), W4955 (disclosure), W4960 (improvement)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Control-deficiency risk**: Material weakness in collateral controls → audit/bank finding; mitigated by the audit program and CAPA
- **Remediation-lag risk**: Issues not remediated on time → repeat findings/bank escalation; mitigated by CAPA tracking
- **Assurance-gap risk**: Audit scope misses a material area; mitigated by risk-based scoping and bank-finding coordination
System Touchpoints: - Internal audit (VS-21); treasury/borrowing-base (VS-18); CAPA tracking (VS-21); audit committee reporting (VS-36); analytics (VS-28)

steps.activity: Audit the collateral-financing program: test certificate accuracy (W4939), eligibility testing (W4940/W4941), availability controls (W4942), proceeds segregation (W4947), release authorization (W4952), covenant compliance (W4944), and disclosure (W4955); coordinate with the bank's field-exam findings (W4943) and external audit (VS-21)
Manage issues & remediation: log audit/bank findings, root-cause, assign remediation owners/dates, track to closure, and verify effectiveness; manage any control deficiencies (VS-21 CAPA)
steps.r: Internal Audit / ABL Manager / Process Owners

steps.activity: Report & assure: report program audit results and remediation status to the audit committee (VS-36) and management, provide bank-covenant assurance, and feed continuous improvement (W4960)

fields.Owner: Treasury / Finance / ABL & Collateral Operations Manager
fields.Volume: ~1 settlement/reconciliation per facility per month × 1–3 facilities

workflows.name: Interest Accrual, Charge Settlement & Bank Fee Reconciliation

Automation Opportunity: - Interest auto-accrue from facility/draws; bank-statement auto-reconcile; variance auto-flag; entity auto-allocation
Controls: - CTL-742 (ensure controlled execution — Collateral Release, Reconciliation, Compliance & Analytics (PA-170.3).)
- CTL-742 (monthly accrual & reconciliation; bank charges disputed on variance; effective-rate validated; cost allocated (VS-72))
Cross-references: - links to VS-17.1 (close), VS-18 (treasury), VS-15 (AP), VS-72 (allocation), W4956 (effective-rate analytics), W4937 (facility terms)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Mis-accrual risk**: Interest/charges mis-accrued → P&L distortion; mitigated by monthly accrual & reconciliation
- **Over-charge risk**: Bank over-charges (rate/fee error) undisputed → cost leakage; mitigated by statement reconciliation and dispute
- **Allocation-error risk**: Charges mis-allocated across entities; mitigated by the VS-72 allocation
System Touchpoints: - Treasury/debt facility (VS-18); GL (VS-17); AP (VS-15); intercompany allocation (VS-72); bank portal; analytics (VS-28)

steps.activity: Accrue interest & charges: accrue interest on drawn balances, commitment fee on undrawn, utilization/capitalized fees, field-exam/collateral-manager fees, and other facility charges; post to the GL (VS-17) by entity/facility

Settle & reconcile bank charges: receive the bank billing statement, settle the charges, reconcile to the accrual, investigate variances (rate/fee/days), and correct; allocate cost across entities (VS-72)
Validate effective rate & feed analytics: confirm the settled charges reconcile to the effective-rate analytics (W4956), flag cost anomalies, and report to management

fields.Owner: Treasurer / ABL & Collateral Operations Manager / Strategy
fields.Participants: Treasury (VS-18), Finance/FP&A (VS-17.4/VS-33), Supply Chain (VS-02), AR (VS-16), Data (VS-28)
fields.Trigger: Strategic review (VS-33); stress event; refinance (W4937); improvement cycle

workflows.name: Financing Program Continuous Improvement, Stress-Testing & Strategy Feedback

Automation Opportunity: - Scenario/stress modeling; covenant-headroom projection; improvement-tracking; strategy-feed dashboards
Controls: - CTL-742 (ensure controlled execution — Collateral Release, Reconciliation, Compliance & Analytics (PA-170.3).)
- CTL-742 (annual stress-test; improvement actions tracked; strategy aligned to growth; reported to board (VS-36))
Cross-references: - links to VS-18 (treasury/cash), VS-17.4/VS-33 (FP&A/strategy), VS-105 (SCF), VS-29 (data), VS-02.3/VS-26 (stress), VS-36 (board), W4937 (strategy), W4956 (analytics), W4958 (audit)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Stress-blindness risk**: Unmodeled stress → covenant breach surprise; mitigated by annual stress-testing
- **Improvement-lag risk**: Analytics/audit findings not actioned; mitigated by the improvement cycle and tracking
- **Strategy-disconnect risk**: Financing not aligned to growth (new stores/imports); mitigated by the strategy feedback loop
System Touchpoints: - Treasury/analytics (VS-18/VS-28); FP&A (VS-17.4/VS-33); stress/scenario modeling (VS-02.3/VS-26); board reporting (VS-36)

steps.activity: Stress-test the financing program: model liquidity/availability under stress scenarios (import disruption VS-02.3, demand shock, AR bad-debt VS-16 W81, inventory write-down VS-05.3, rate/FX shock VS-18.3) and the covenant headroom impact (W4944)

Identify improvements: from analytics (W4956), audit (W4958), field exams (W4943), and stress tests, identify advance-rate/eligibility/process/control improvements, SCF-vs-ABL rebalancing (VS-105), and data-quality investments (VS-29)

Feed strategy & close the loop: feed refinancing/resize/restructure strategy (W4937), the funding plan (VS-18.2), the capital-structure plan (VS-33), and the board finance committee (VS-36); track improvement outcomes
